items.title: Afghanistan
items.summary: Afghanistan, officially the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan is a country in Asia. It borders Pakistan in the south and east (border with India is disputed), Iran in the west, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan and Tajikistan in the north, and China in the far northeast.

items.title: Albania
items.summary: Albania, officially called the Republic of Albania is an independent country located in Southeast Europe, more specifically it is located in the Balkans. The capital is Tirana, and other important cities are Durrës, Elbasan and Vlora.

items.title: Algeria
items.summary: Algeria, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria is a North African country. It is the second biggest nation in Africa and the 10th largest world over in terms of total land area.

items.title: Andorra
items.summary: Andorra, officially the Principality of Andorra, is a landlocked sovereign country located in the eastern Pyrenees Mountains of Southern Europe and bordered by Spain and France.

items.title: Angola
items.summary: Angola, officially the Republic of Angola, is a country in southern Africa. It shares borders with Namibia in the south, the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the north, and Zambia in the east.

items.title: Antigua and Barbuda
items.summary: Antigua and Barbuda is an island nation in the eastern Caribbean Sea on the boundary with the Atlantic Ocean. Antigua and Barbuda are part of the Lesser Antilles archipelago.

items.title: Argentina
items.summary: Argentina, officially the Argentine Republic, is a country in South America. Argentina is the second-largest country in South America and the eighth-largest country in the world.

items.title: Armenia
items.summary: Armenia, officially the Republic of Armenia, is a landlocked country located in the Armenian Highlands in the Caucasus region of Eastern Europe and Western Asia.

items.title: Australia
items.summary: Australia, officially the Commonwealth of Australia, is an island country and sovereign state located in the southern hemisphere, in Oceania. Its capital city is Canberra, and its largest city is Sydney.

items.title: Austria
items.summary: Austria, officially the Republic of Austria, is a country in Central Europe. Around Austria are the countries of Germany, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia, Italy, Switzerland, and Liechtenstein.

items.title: Azerbaijan
items.summary: Azerbaijan (officially called the Republic of Azerbaijan) is a country in the South Caucasus region of Eurasia. It borders on Russia in the north, Georgia and, Armenia in the west, Iran in the south, and the Caspian Sea on the east.

items.title: Bahrain
items.summary: Bahrain (officially called Kingdom of Bahrain) is an island country in the Persian Gulf. Saudi Arabia is to the west and is connected to Bahrain by the King Fahd Causeway, and Qatar is to the south across the Persian Gulf.

items.title: Bangladesh
items.summary: Bangladesh, officially called the People's Republic of Bangladesh, is a country in South Asia.

items.title: Barbados
items.summary: Barbados is an island country in the Atlantic Ocean. The island has an area of about 430 km².

items.title: Belarus
items.summary: Belarus (officially called Republic of Belarus) is a country in Eastern Europe. About nine million people live there.

items.title: Belgium
items.summary: Belgium (officially the Kingdom of Belgium) is a country in Western Europe. Its capital, Brussels, is the home of many organizations, including the European Union and NATO.

items.title: Belize
items.summary: Belize is a country in Central America. It used to be called British Honduras, but changed its name in 1973.

items.title: Benin
items.summary: Benin (officially called the Republic of Benin) is a country in Africa. The capital of Benin is Porto-Novo.

items.title: Bhutan
items.summary: Bhutan (officially called Kingdom of Bhutan) is a small landlocked country in the Himalaya mountains of South Asia. It is ruled by King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck, who has been king since 2006.

items.title: Bolivia
items.summary: Bolivia, officially the Plurinational State of Bolivia, is a country in South America. It is landlocked by Brazil, Paraguay, Argentina, Peru, and Chile.

items.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina
items.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina, abbreviated BiH or B&H, sometimes called Bosnia–Herzegovina and often known informally as Bosnia, is a country in Southeastern Europe, located in the Balkans with an area of 51,197 km2 and 4,600,000 people.

items.title: Botswana
items.summary: Botswana (officially called the Republic of Botswana) is a country in southern Africa. The capital of Botswana is Gaborone.

items.title: Brazil
items.summary: Brazil, officially the Federative Republic of Brazil, is a country in South America. It is the world's fifth-largest country by area, behind Russia, Canada, the United States, and China, with a total area of 8,514,877 square kilometers (3,287,612 sq mi).

items.title: Brunei
items.summary: Brunei Darussalam (officially called the State of Brunei, Abode of Peace, or simply Brunei) is a country in Southeast Asia. It is located on the northern coast of the island of Borneo and is surrounded on its landward sides by Malaysia.

items.title: Bulgaria
items.summary: Bulgaria (officially called the Republic of Bulgaria) is a country in south-eastern Europe, on the Balkan Peninsula. Bulgaria is the south of the River Danube and west of the Black Sea.

items.title: Burkina Faso
items.summary: Burkina Faso is a country in West Africa. It used to be called Upper Volta and the name was changed to Burkina Faso in 1984.

items.title: Burundi
items.summary: Burundi (officially called the Republic of Burundi) is a small cunt tree in Africa. The capital of Burundi is Tukyukyuk.

items.title: Cambodia
items.summary: Cambodia or Kampuchea (officially called Kingdom of Cambodia) is a country in Southeast Asia. It is near Vietnam, Laos, and Thailand.

items.title: Cameroon
items.summary: Cameroon (officially called the Republic of Cameroon) is a country in Central Africa. Its capital is Yaoundé.

items.title: Canada
items.summary: Canada is a country in North America. Its land reaches from the Atlantic Ocean to the east to the Pacific Ocean to the west.

items.title: Cape Verde
items.summary: Cape Verde or Cabo Verde, officially the Republic of Cabo Verde, is an island country in Africa. It is a group of islands in the Atlantic Ocean, 570 km (354 mi) off the coast of Western Africa.

items.title: Central African Republic
items.summary: The Central African Republic (CAR) (Sango Ködörösêse tî Bêafrîka), formerly Ubangi-Shari, is a landlocked country in Central Africa. It is mostly a plateau or high, flat piece of land about 941 metres above the sea.

items.title: Chad
items.summary: Chad (officially called the Republic of Chad) is a landlocked country in Central Africa. The capital is N'Djamena.

items.title: Chile
items.summary: Chile, officially the Republic of Chile, is a country on the south-western side of South America. Most people there speak Spanish.

items.title: Colombia
items.summary: Colombia officially the Republic of Colombia, is a tropical equatorial country in northern South America. It is in the northwest part of the continent, and it has an area of 1 141 748 km2 (440 839 sq mi).

items.title: Comoros
items.summary: Comoros (officially called Union of the Comoros) is a small island nation in the Indian Ocean. It is between Madagascar and mainland Africa.

items.title: Costa Rica
items.summary: Costa Rica, officially the Republic of Costa Rica, is a country in Central America. It borders Nicaragua and Panama.

items.title: Croatia
items.summary: Croatia is a unitary democratic parliamentary republic in Central and Southeastern Europe. Croatia has been influenced by powers from both regions at varying points in its history.

items.title: Cuba
items.summary: Cuba is an island country in the Caribbean Sea. The country is made up of the big island of Cuba, the Isla de la Juventud island (Isle of Youth), and many smaller islands.

items.title: Cyprus
items.summary: Cyprus (officially the Republic of Cyprus) is an island country in the Mediterranean Sea. Cyprus is in Asia, along with being apart of the Middle East and the Levant (but politically, part of modern Europe).

items.title: Czech Republic
items.summary: The Czech Republic, otherwise referred to as Czechia, is a country in Central Europe. The capital and biggest city is Prague.

items.title: Democratic Republic of the Congo
items.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo, commonly referred to as DR Congo, Congo-Kinshasa or the DRC, is a country in central Africa. It was known as Zaïre from 1971 to 1997.

items.title: Denmark
items.summary: Denmark, officially named the Kingdom of Denmark, is a Nordic country in Northern Europe.

items.title: Djibouti
items.summary: Djibouti (officially called the Republic of Djibouti) is a country on the eastern coast of Africa. The capital city is also called Djibouti.

items.title: Dominica
items.summary: The Commonwealth of Dominica is an island nation in the Caribbean Sea. It is an English-speaking country.

items.title: Dominican Republic
items.summary: The Dominican Republic is a Latin American country on the Caribbean island of Hispaniola; the other country on the island is Haiti. Its capital, and largest city, is Santo Domingo.

items.title: East Timor
items.summary: East Timor or the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste is a country in Southeast Asia. It is on the eastern side of the island of Timor.

items.title: Ecuador
items.summary: Ecuador is a small country in South America. It used to be part of the Spanish Empire and Gran Colombia.

items.title: Egypt
items.summary: Egypt, officially the Republic of Egypt, is a country in the Middle East and the Eastern Mediterranean, located in North Africa and Western Asia.

items.title: El Salvador
items.summary: El Salvador, officially the Republic of El Salvador, is a country in Central America. It borders Honduras and Guatemala.

items.title: Equatorial Guinea
items.summary: The Republic of Equatorial Guinea is a nation in west central Africa, and one of the smallest countries in Africa. It borders Cameroon on the north, Gabon on the south and east, and the Gulf of Guinea on the west.

items.title: Eritrea
items.summary: Eritrea is a country on the eastern coast of Africa. Its official name is The State of Eritrea.

items.title: Estonia
items.summary: Estonia, officially the Republic of Estonia is a country by the Baltic Sea in Northern Europe. The capital city is Tallinn.

items.title: Eswatini
items.summary: Eswatini (or Swaziland) is a country in Africa. It is officially the Kingdom of eSwatini (Umbuso weSwatini).

items.title: Ethiopia
items.summary: Ethiopia has one of the longest known histories as a country in Africa. Ethiopia was one of the few countries in Africa that escaped the Scramble for Africa.

items.title: Federated States of Micronesia
items.summary: Micronesia, officially the Federated States of Micronesia, is an island nation in the Pacific Ocean, northeast of Papua New Guinea. The country is a sovereign state in free association with the United States.

items.title: Fiji
items.summary: Fiji is an island country in the Pacific Ocean. It has 322 islands.

items.title: Finland
items.summary: Finland is a country in Northern Europe and is a member state of the European Union and NATO. Finland is one of the Nordic countries and is also part of Fennoscandia.

items.title: France
items.summary: France, officially the French Republic, is a country in Western Europe. It also includes various departments and territories of France overseas.

items.title: Gabon
items.summary: Gabon, officially the Gabonese Republic, is a country in Africa. It is located on the equator.

items.title: Georgia
items.summary: Georgia is a country in the Caucasus region of West Asia and Eastern Europe. It is situated on the coast of the Black Sea and borders Russia to the north, Turkey and Armenia to the south, and Azerbaijan to the southeast.

items.title: Germany
items.summary: Germany is a country in the western region of Central Europe. The country's full name is sometimes shortened to the FRG (or the BRD, in German).

items.title: Ghana
items.summary: Ghana (formerly the Gold Coast) is a country in West Africa. Thirty-one million people live there; its capital was once Cape Coast, but now it is Accra.

items.title: Greece
items.summary: Greece, officially the Hellenic Republic, historically known as Hellas, is a country mostly located in Southeastern Europe with small island territories in Asia. Its capital city is Athens.

items.title: Grenada
items.summary: Grenada is an island country in the Caribbean Sea that received its independence from the United Kingdom in 1974. Its capital is St. George's.

items.title: Guatemala
items.summary: Guatemala, officially the Republic of Guatemala, is a country in Central America. It borders Mexico, Belize, Honduras, and El Salvador.

items.title: Guinea
items.summary: Guinea, or the Republic of Guinea, is an independent nation in Western Africa. Guinea borders 6 countries: Guinea-Bissau, Senegal, Mali, Ivory Coast, Liberia, Sierra Leone.

items.title: Guinea-Bissau
items.summary: Guinea-Bissau is a country in Africa. It borders Senegal to the north, Guinea to the south.

items.title: Guyana
items.summary: The Co-operative Republic of Guyana (formerly British Guiana) is a country in South America. It is one of the most sparsely populated countries in the world (700,000 people live there inside its over 200,000 km² of area).

items.title: Haiti
items.summary: Haiti, officially the Republic of Haiti is a country on the Caribbean island of Hispaniola. The other country on the island is the Dominican Republic.

items.title: Honduras
items.summary: Honduras, officially the Republic of Honduras, is a country in Central America. It borders Guatemala, El Salvador and Nicaragua.

items.title: Hungary
items.summary: Hungary is a landlocked country in Southeastern Central Europe. It is bordered by Slovakia to the North, Ukraine to the Northeast, Romania to the East and southeast, Serbia to the South, Croatia and Slovenia to the Southwest, and Austria to the west.

items.title: Iceland
items.summary: Iceland is an island country between the North Atlantic and Arctic, between Greenland and Norway. It is culturally considered to be part of Europe.

items.title: India
items.summary: India, officially the Republic of India, also known as Hindustān, is a country in South Asia. It is the world's seventh-largest country by area.

items.title: Indonesia
items.summary: Indonesia, officially the Republic of Indonesia, is a nation in Southeast Asia and Oceania. As the biggest archipelago country in the world, Indonesia has 17,504 islands.

items.title: Iran
items.summary: Iran, officially the Islamic Republic of Iran and also known as Persia, is a country in Western Asia. Prior to 1935, the country was referred to by majority in the Western world as Persia.

items.title: Iraq
items.summary: Iraq is a country in southwestern Asia. Iraq borders Saudi Arabia and Kuwait to the south, Turkey to the north, Syria to the northwest, Jordan to the west, and Iran to the east.

items.title: Israel
items.summary: Israel, officially the State of Israel, is a country in southwestern Asia on the eastern side of the Mediterranean Sea. Its capital city is Jerusalem.

items.title: Italy
items.summary: Italy is a country in Southern Europe with small island territories in North Africa. It is a founding member of the European Union and a member of the G7 and G20, as it has the eighth largest gross domestic product in the world.

items.title: Ivory Coast
items.summary: Ivory Coast or Côte d'Ivoire, officially the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, is a country in West Africa.

items.title: Jamaica
items.summary: Jamaica is an island country in the Caribbean; it is part of the Greater Antilles. The island, 10,990 square kilometres (4,240 sq mi) in area, lies about 140 kilometres (87 mi) south of Cuba, and 191 kilometres (119 mi) west of Hispaniola.

items.title: Japan
items.summary: Japan is a country in East Asia. It is a group of islands close to the east coast of Korea, China and Russia.

items.title: Jordan
items.summary: Jordan (officially the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan) is an Arab country in southwest Asia, in the Middle East, in the southern part of the Levant region, and the northern part of the Arabian Peninsula.

items.title: Kazakhstan
items.summary: Kazakhstan is a landlocked country in the middle of Eurasia. Its official name is the Republic of Kazakhstan.

items.title: Kenya
items.summary: Kenya is a country in East Africa, about halfway down the continent, near the Horn of Africa. It is about the size of France, and almost as large as the U.S. state of Texas.

items.title: Kiribati
items.summary: Kiribati is an island country in the Pacific Ocean. It has 33 atolls, groups of tiny islands.

items.title: Kosovo
items.summary: Kosovo is a partially recognised country located in Southeastern Europe. Until 2008, Kosovo was a part of Serbia.

items.title: Kuwait
items.summary: Kuwait is a small Arab country (about 17,819 square kilometers) in the Middle East.

items.title: Kyrgyzstan
items.summary: Kyrgyzstan, officially the Kyrgyz Republic, is a country in Central Asia. The country is landlocked (has no coast) and mountainous.

items.title: Laos
items.summary: Laos, officially the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), is a country in Southeast Asia.

items.title: Latvia
items.summary: Latvia, officially the Republic of Latvia (Latvijas Republika), is a country in Northern Europe. The capital is Riga.

items.title: Lebanon
items.summary: Lebanon is a country in the Middle East, in Western Asia, next to the Mediterranean Sea. It has borders with Israel to the south and Syria to the east and north.

items.title: Lesotho
items.summary: Lesotho is a small country in southern Africa. It is entirely surrounded by South Africa.

items.title: Liberia
items.summary: The Republic of Liberia is a small country on the coast of West Africa. It has common borders with Sierra Leone, Guinea, and Ivory Coast.

items.title: Libya
items.summary: Libya, officially the State of Libya, is a country in North Africa. It is bordered by the Mediterranean Sea to the north, Egypt to the east, Sudan to the southeast, Chad and Niger to the south, and Algeria and Tunisia to the west.

items.title: Liechtenstein
items.summary: Liechtenstein, officially the Principality of Liechtenstein, is a small country in the middle of Europe. It is a landlocked country, meaning it has no coastline.

items.title: Lithuania
items.summary: Lithuania is a country in Europe. It borders Latvia to the north, Belarus to the southeast, Poland to the south and Russia to the southwest.

items.title: Luxembourg
items.summary: Luxembourg officially called the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg is a landlocked country in Western Europe.

items.title: Madagascar
items.summary: Madagascar is a large island nation in the Indian Ocean. It is off of the East coast of Africa and its capital is Antananarivo.

items.title: Malawi
items.summary: Malawi (Republic of Malawi) is a country in south-east Africa. It has borders with the countries of Tanzania, Zambia, and Mozambique.

items.title: Malaysia
items.summary: Malaysia is a country in Southeast Asia. The federal constitutional monarchy consists of thirteen states and three federal territories, separated by the South China Sea into two regions, Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo's East Malaysia.

items.title: Maldives
items.summary: The Maldives are a group of islands in the Indian Ocean. They are southwest of India.

items.title: Mali
items.summary: Mali, officially the Republic of Mali is a landlocked country (a country entirely surrounded by land) in West Africa.

items.title: Malta
items.summary: Malta is a country in Southern Europe, and a member of the European Union. It is an island near the center of the Mediterranean Sea, south of Sicily.

items.title: Marshall Islands
items.summary: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) is a Micronesian island nation in the western Pacific Ocean. As of 2018, about 58,000 people live there.

items.title: Mauritania
items.summary: Mauritania is a country in northwest Africa. The capital city, which is also the biggest city in the country, is Nouakchott.

items.title: Mauritius
items.summary: The Republic of Mauritius is an island nation in the Mascarene Islands. It includes Rodrigues, Agaléga and St. Brandon as well as Mauritius.

items.title: Mexico
items.summary: Mexico, officially the United Mexican States, is a country in North America.

items.title: Moldova
items.summary: Moldova is a country in Eastern Europe. Its full name is the Republic of Moldova It used to be called Moldavia.

items.title: Monaco
items.summary: Monaco, officially the Principality of Monaco, is a city state and the second smallest country in the world after the Vatican City. Monaco is a city-state, meaning that the entire country is just one city.

items.title: Mongolia
items.summary: Mongolia is a landlocked country in East Asia. It has a border with Russia to the north and the People's Republic of China to the south and southeast.

items.title: Montenegro
items.summary: Montenegro (meaning Black Mountain) is a small country in Southeastern Europe. It is on the Adriatic Sea, between Albania (to the South) and Croatia to the North.

items.title: Morocco
items.summary: Morocco, officially the Kingdom of Morocco, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa.

items.title: Mozambique
items.summary: Mozambique, officially the Republic of Mozambique, is a country in southeastern Africa. Its capital is Maputo.

items.title: Myanmar
items.summary: Myanmar, formerly and occasionally called Burma in English, is a country in Southeast Asia. Its full name is the Republic of the Union of Myanmar.

items.title: Namibia
items.summary: The Republic of Namibia is a country in southern Africa on the Atlantic coast. It is bordered by the countries of Angola and Zambia to the north, Botswana to the east, and South Africa to the south.

items.title: Nauru
items.summary: Nauru, officially the Republic of Naoero, is a island nation in the South Pacific. Its nearest neighbour is Kiribati, 300 kilometres (190 mi) east.

items.title: Nepal
items.summary: Nepal, officially called the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal, is a country in South Asia that doesn't border any ocean. It's mostly in the Himalayas, but also includes parts of the Indo-Gangetic Plain.

items.title: Netherlands
items.summary: The Netherlands (also referred to as Holland) is a country that is part (of a constituent country) of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Most of it is in Western Europe, but there are also some parts in the Caribbean.

items.title: New Zealand
items.summary: New Zealand (known as Aotearoa, in the Māori language) officially Commonwealth of New Zealand, is an island country in Oceania. It is a sovereign state in the south-western part of the Pacific Ocean.

items.title: Nicaragua
items.summary: Nicaragua, officially the Republic of Nicaragua, is a country in Central America. It borders, El Salvador, Honduras, and Costa Rica.

items.title: Niger
items.summary: Niger or the Niger, officially the Republic of the Niger, is a country in western Africa. The capital is Niamey, and the official language is Hausa.

items.title: Nigeria
items.summary: Nigeria, officially Federal Republic of Nigeria, is a country in Africa.

items.title: North Korea
items.summary: North Korea, officially called the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) is a country in the northern part of the Korean peninsula in East Asia. North Korea is next to China, Russia, and South Korea.

items.title: North Macedonia
items.summary: North Macedonia (officially the Republic of North Macedonia) is a country located on the Balkan peninsula in Southeastern Europe.

items.title: Norway
items.summary: Norway is a country in the north of Europe. It is the western part of the Scandinavian peninsula.

items.title: Oman
items.summary: Oman, officially the Sultanate of Oman, is a country in the southwestern part of Asia, on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula. It borders the United Arab Emirates to the northwest, Saudi Arabia to the west, and Yemen to the southwest.

items.title: Pakistan
items.summary: Pakistan, officially the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, is a country in South Asia. It shares its border with other countries India, Iran, Afghanistan and China (disputed with India).

items.title: Palau
items.summary: Palau, officially the Republic of Palau, is an island nation. It is in the Pacific Ocean.

items.title: Palestine
items.summary: Palestine, officially the State of Palestine, is a country in southwestern Asia.

items.title: Panama
items.summary: Panama is a country in Central America. Its official name is the Republic of Panama, and it's most famous for the Panama Canal.

items.title: Papua New Guinea
items.summary: Papua New Guinea is an island country located on the Pacific Ocean. It is the east half of New Guinea island, plus some nearby islands.

items.title: Paraguay
items.summary: Paraguay, officially the Republic of Paraguay, is a small country in South America. It is landlocked, meaning that it is not next to the ocean.

items.title: People's Republic of China
items.summary: The People's Republic of China (PRC) is a Communist one-party state in East Asia governed by the Communist Party of China (CPC). It was founded on 1 October 1949 after the Kuomintang (KMT) fled to Taiwan.

items.title: Peru
items.summary: Peru is a country in South America. The capital is Lima.

items.title: Philippines
items.summary: The Philippines is an island country in Southeast Asia in the Pacific Ocean. It has 7,641 islands.

items.title: Poland
items.summary: Poland is a country in the eastern region of Central Europe. Its official name is Republic of Poland.

items.title: Portugal
items.summary: Portugal is a country in Southern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula. It is bordered by the North Atlantic Ocean to the west and south and by Spain to the north and east.

items.title: Qatar
items.summary: Qatar, officially the State of Qatar, is a sovereign country in Western Asia. It is on the small Qatari-Peninsula on the northeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula.

items.title: Republic of Ireland
items.summary: Ireland is a European country on the island of Ireland. It shares a border with Northern Ireland (which is part of the United Kingdom).

items.title: Republic of the Congo
items.summary: The Republic of the Congo, also known as Congo-Brazzaville, is a country in Africa. Its capital city is Brazzaville.

items.title: Romania
items.summary: Romania is a country in Eastern and Southeastern Europe. It is north of the Balkan Peninsula, on the Lower Danube River.

items.title: Russia
items.summary: Russia, or the Russian Federation, is a country spanning parts of Eastern Europe and North Asia. It has land from the Baltic Sea to the Bering Strait.

items.title: Rwanda
items.summary: Rwanda is a country in East Africa. It is landlocked, meaning it has no ocean coast.

items.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis
items.summary: The Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis (also known as the Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis), is a federal nation made up of two small islands in the Caribbean Sea. It is the smallest independent country in the Western Hemisphere.

items.title: Saint Lucia
items.summary: Saint Lucia is a tropical island country in the eastern Caribbean Sea. It is a part of the Lesser Antilles island group, and it is north of the islands of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines and south of Martinique.

items.title: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
items.summary: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is an island nation in the Caribbean Sea. It is a member of the Commonwealth of Nations, the Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States and CARICOM.

items.title: Samoa
items.summary: The Independent State of Samoa is a country in the Pacific Ocean. It became independent from New Zealand in 1962.

items.title: San Marino
items.summary: San Marino (officially called the Most Serene Republic of San Marino) is a country in Europe. It is one of the smallest countries in the world.

items.title: São Tomé and Príncipe
items.summary: São Tomé and Príncipe, officially the Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe is an island nation in Central Africa, it is located off the Gulf of Guinea.

items.title: Saudi Arabia
items.summary: Saudi Arabia, officially known as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), is a country in West Asia including most of the Arabian Peninsula.

items.title: Senegal
items.summary: The Republic of Senegal (French République da Sénégal) is a country in West Africa. The capital is Dakar.

items.title: Serbia
items.summary: Serbia, officially the Republic of Serbia, is a country in Southeastern Europe, and a part of the Balkans. The capital city is Belgrade.

items.title: Seychelles
items.summary: Seychelles is an African country in the Indian Ocean. Its capital city is Victoria.

items.title: Sierra Leone
items.summary: Sierra Leone is a country in West Africa. Its capital is Freetown.

items.title: Singapore
items.summary: Singapore, officially the Republic of Singapore, is a sovereign country. It is nicknamed as 'The Lion City', 'The Garden City' or 'The Little Red Dot'.

items.title: Slovakia
items.summary: Slovakia (Official name The Slovak Republic, Slovenská republika) is a landlocked country in the eastern region of Central Europe. It is bordered by Austria in the southwest, Hungary in the south, Ukraine in the east, Poland in the north and Czech Republic in the northwest.

items.title: Slovenia
items.summary: Slovenia is a country in the region of Central Europe. The capital and largest city of Slovenia is Ljubljana.

items.title: Solomon Islands
items.summary: Solomon Islands are a group of islands in the South Pacific that make up a country. They are known for their beauty and for the many languages spoken there.

items.title: Somalia
items.summary: Somalia, officially called the Federal Republic of Somalia, is a country located on the Horn of Africa. It used to be known as the Somali Republic.

items.title: South Africa
items.summary: South Africa, officially called the Republic of South Africa, is a country in the southern region of Africa. About fifty-seven million people live there.

items.title: South Korea
items.summary: South Korea is a country in the southern part of the Korean peninsula, in East Asia.

items.title: South Sudan
items.summary: South Sudan is a country in East Africa. Its official name is the Republic of South Sudan.

items.title: Spain
items.summary: Spain is a country in Europe that controls much of the Iberian Peninsula and nearby islands. The people of Spain are called Spaniards, and in 2026, the population of Spain was about 49.8 million.

items.title: Sri Lanka
items.summary: The Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka is a tropical island nation located in the Indian Ocean just off the Southern coast of India. The capital of the country is Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte while the largest city is Colombo.

items.title: Sudan
items.summary: Sudan is a country in East Africa. The official name of Sudan is The Republic of the Sudan.

items.title: Suriname
items.summary: Suriname or Surinam is a country in South America. The official name of the country is Republiek Suriname (this is Dutch and translates to Republic of Suriname).

items.title: Sweden
items.summary: Sweden is a Nordic country in the part of Europe called Scandinavia. Its neighbors are Finland and Norway.

items.title: Switzerland
items.summary: Switzerland is a country in Western Europe. Switzerland is a federation of 26 cantons.

items.title: Syria
items.summary: Syria, officially the Syrian Arab Republic, is a country in West Asia. It is located in the Eastern Mediterranean and the Levant.

items.title: Taiwan
items.summary: The Republic of China (ROC), commonly known as Taiwan, is a self-governing country in East Asia. The Republic of China once governed all of China (from 1911 to 1949) but moved to the island of Taiwan after their defeat in a Chinese civil war.

items.title: Tajikistan
items.summary: Tajikistan is a country in Central Asia. It was previously part of the Soviet Union.

items.title: Tanzania
items.summary: Tanzania is a country in East Africa. The official languages are Kiswahili and English.

items.title: Thailand
items.summary: Thailand, officially the Kingdom of Thailand, is a country in Southeast Asia. Its neighbours are Laos, Cambodia, Malaysia, and Myanmar.

items.title: The Bahamas
items.summary: The Bahamas (officially called Commonwealth of The Bahamas) are a group of islands in the Caribbean Sea. The country's capital, Nassau, is on New Providence Island.

items.title: The Gambia
items.summary: The Gambia is officially called the Republic of the Gambia. This country is also known as Gambia.

items.title: Togo
items.summary: Togo (officially the Togolese Republic) is a small country in West Africa. It is bordered by Ghana to the west, Benin to the east and Burkina Faso to the north.

items.title: Tonga
items.summary: Tonga is a country in Pacific Ocean. It has 169 islands.

items.title: Trinidad and Tobago
items.summary: Trinidad and Tobago (officially called the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago) is a country in the south Caribbean Sea. It is 11 km (7 miles) away from Venezuela.

items.title: Tunisia
items.summary: Tunisia, officially the Tunisian Republic, is a country in the Arab Maghreb in North Africa. It shares its borders with two countries including Algeria to the west, and Libya to the southeast.

items.title: Turkey
items.summary: Turkey, officially the Republic of Türkiye, is a transcontinental country located mainly on the Anatolian Peninsula in Western Asia, with a small portion on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeast Europe.

items.title: Turkmenistan
items.summary: Turkmenistan, also known as Turkmenia, is a country in South-Central Asia. It has borders with Afghanistan, Iran, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan.

items.title: Tuvalu
items.summary: Tuvalu is a small island country in the Pacific Ocean. In the past, it was the Ellice Islands.

items.title: Uganda
items.summary: The Republic of Uganda is a landlocked country in east Africa.

items.title: Ukraine
items.summary: Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe. It borders Russia, Belarus, Poland, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, and Moldova.

items.title: United Arab Emirates
items.summary: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) is a country in Western Asia. It borders Oman, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia.

items.title: United Kingdom
items.summary: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, often shortened to the United Kingdom, or just Britain, is a sovereign country in Northwestern Europe. It is a constitutional monarchy of four countries: England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.

items.title: United States
items.summary: The United States of America (USA or U.S.A.), also known as the United States (U.S. or US) or America, is a country that is located in North America.

items.title: Uruguay
items.summary: Uruguay (officially named Oriental Republic of Uruguay) is a country in South America. The language spoken there is Spanish.

items.title: Uzbekistan
items.summary: Uzbekistan, officially the Republic of Uzbekistan, is a country in Central Asia. Its capital and largest city is Tashkent.

items.title: Vanuatu
items.summary: Vanuatu is a country in the Pacific Ocean. The official languages of Vanuatu are Bislama, English and French.

items.title: Vatican City
items.summary: Vatican City (officially Vatican City State) (also sometimes referred to as the Vatican) is the smallest country in the world by size, at 44 hectares (110 acres), and the smallest by population. It is also one of the world's three city-states.

items.title: Venezuela
items.summary: Venezuela, officially the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, is a country in northern South America. The official language is Spanish, and the capital city is Caracas.

items.title: Vietnam
items.summary: The Socialist Republic of Vietnam (or just Vietnam) is a country in Southeast Asia. The neighboring countries are Cambodia, China, and Laos.

items.title: Yemen
items.summary: Yemen, officially the Republic of Yemen is a nation in the Middle East. It is the old North Yemen and South Yemen, in the southwestern corner of the Arabian Peninsula.

items.title: Zambia
items.summary: The Republic of Zambia is a country in southern Africa.

items.title: Zimbabwe
items.summary: The Republic of Zimbabwe is a country in the southern part of the continent of Africa. Its capital city is Harare.
